verdict.rationale: Automatic suppression is a fair question for an email marketing platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions automatic suppression of unsubscribes, bounces or spam complaints, or that suppression is honored across every send type. The only nearby item is a generic claim about helping meet 'data security and privacy standards', which is not about suppression hygiene.

support.subject: As an ops user, unsubscribes, bounces, and spam complaints are suppressed automatically and honored across every send type — CAN-SPAM/GDPR hygiene by default
